name: meshy
description: Meshy AI text/image-to-3D traps a model gets wrong from memory: an unknown create outcome is reconciled, never resubmitted; a running task cannot be cancelled; files and signed URLs expire after 3 days; free-plan output is Meshy-owned under CC BY 4.0; rigging takes textured humanoids only. Plus a stdlib Python GLB/glTF checker for triangle, texture-size and required-extension budgets with an exit code.
